# Whether fire stays with every block state, as both official servers decide it with nothing else around (harness
# 0.26.0 fire report): fire in the air with the state east of it (beside: the state is flammable), fire on the
# state (on), soul fire on the state (soul_on). One code per column, 1 or 0, ? when the state did not stay where it
# was set. A bare block name stands for all its states. Columns: beside on soul_on
# Java Edition 1.21.8: every state.
